thread:
Alex M: Heads up — since ~08:12 UTC we've observed sustained egress bandwidth saturation from hosted-rt in us-west-2. Symptoms: customer requests with large responses (embeds/attachments) getting 502/timeout.
Jordan (oncall): jumping in. any impact to Dedicated/Private?
Alex M: only hosted traffic from that cluster right now. Dedicated pools unaffected. Private none.
Marisol: creating incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1805001234 — adding early mitigations section.
OpsBot: [AUTOMATION] Alert: Network egress utilization > 92% on hosted-rt-usw2-natgw-3 for 7m.
Jordan (oncall): quick mitigation applied: enabled per-client egress shaping for large payloads (policy tmp-egress-cap). This should shed the largest flows while we scale.
Ken C (CS): flagging customers on watch list — queued messages to top-5 affected accounts with temporary retry guidance.
Alex M: taking two actions in parallel: 1) request cloud team to scale NAT GW and provision additional egress capacity; 2) start traffic rebalancing to hosted-rt-usw2-nodegroup-b (lower-utilized AZ).
Marisol: added playbook steps in doc, section "egress-shedding-steps". ETA for cloud scaling 15-25m per cloud team.
SRE Bot: runbook snippet: ```
# show top egress flows
sudo tc -s -d qdisc show dev eth0
sudo conntrack -L | grep hosted-rt | head -n 20
``` 
Jordan (oncall): rolling a small config change to reduce max response chunk size to 1MB for streaming endpoints — pushing canary now.
Alex M: canary looks good on 3 hosts, 502 rate dropped ~60% in canary pool.
Ken C (CS): customers receiving notices are acknowledging, one reported degraded UX but still functional.
Marisol: updating incident doc timeline and customer impact table. Linking status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1805001234
Jordan (oncall): cloud team confirmed NAT GW scaled +2 units, egress utilization dropped to ~68%.
OpsBot: [METRIC] 502s in hosted-rt-usw2: 08:15 UTC 180/min -> 08:48 UTC 72/min -> 09:12 UTC 8/min.
Alex M: mitigation validated. next steps: keep per-client shaping for 2h, roll change to all hosts, follow with postmortem.
Marisol: drafting postmortem template; assigning owners: Alex (root cause), Jordan (mitigation timeline), Ken (customer comms).
Jordan (oncall): moving to monitoring state. If anything regresses, reopen thread.
Alex M: thanks everyone. marking this as status: mitigated. :white_check_mark:
Marisol: final note — we'll schedule a follow-up postmortem review tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Invite sent.
SRE Bot: [CLOSED] Incident marked mitigated at 09:20 UTC.
